subject: {first_name}, your {streak}-day streak breaks in a few hours
preview_text: One chart scan keeps it alive.
body_paragraphs: You're on a {streak}-day analysis streak. That's rare — most people open a trading app once and disappear.
Tip: one scan of the pair you actually trade keeps the streak — you don't need a full research session.
Open Command, upload that chart, read the stop, and you're done for today.
P.S. Streaks aren't about grinding — they're about showing up with a written process.
